notes: Variant WLC.JOS.4.18.v001 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base; both readings remain compatible with the ASV and no fallback exclusion is marked, so nothing follows from it under rule 53.
The and before the soles is added: the נתקו clause is asyndetic in Hebrew, while the apodosis waw carries the frame's that (rules 14, 45).
כַּעֲלוֹת is a temporal כְּ plus infinitive construct, not כאשר, so the preposition takes when under rule 52 and the infinitive keeps were come up.
